title: Network performance issues in Los Angeles (LAX) and Frankfurt (FRA) datacenters

timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating issues with network performance in Los Angeles (LAX), United States and Frankfurt (FRA), Germany datacenters. We are working to analyse and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
